usdRate.sourceName: Banco de México (SIE) CF102, tipo de cambio FIX
usdRate.note: FIX rate MXN 18.7962 per US dollar on 30 October 2026; World Bank 2025 average 19.24.

inflation_cpi.sourceName: Banco de México (SIE), Inflación, cuadro CP151 (INPC, INEGI)
inflation_cpi.note: Headline CPI (INPC) rose 3.45% in the 12 months to September 2026; core 3.75%. World Bank 2025 average 3.81%.

inflation_projection.sourceName: Banxico inflation target 3% ±1 point; 5-year CPI average about 5% (2021-2025, World Bank)
inflation_projection.note: Inflation has been back near 3.5% in 2026 but averaged well above the 3% target over five years, so planning uses 4%, the top of Banxico's tolerance range.

policy_rate.sourceName: Banco de México, tasa objetivo (anuncios de política monetaria 2026)
policy_rate.note: Target overnight interbank rate 6.50%, cut 25 bp on 26 March and 7 May 2026 and held on 25 June, 6 August and 24 September 2026 (still 6.50% on 1 November, SIE CF101).

savings_account_rate.note: Banxico's weighted gross rate on savings deposits (CF117) was 9.53% in September 2026, but it is pulled up by high-yield digital accounts and is not typical of ordinary accounts at large banks; no typical large-bank savings rate was found.

fdr_3m_rate.sourceName: Banco de México (SIE) CF117, ventanilla rate at opening, depósitos a plazo fijo 3 meses, gross
fdr_3m_rate.note: Average counter (posted) gross rate on 3-month fixed deposits, September 2026 (4.31% net); the weighted gross rate actually paid on 90-day deposits was 6.34%.

fdr_1y_rate.note: Banxico's CF117 table publishes counter and weighted rates for terms up to 6 months (6-month fixed deposits 4.57% gross, September 2026) but no 1-year deposit rate was found.

dps_rate.note: No monthly recurring deposit product with a published average rate was found in Banxico's deposit-rate tables.

bank_deposit_avg_rate.sourceName: Banco de México (SIE) CF112, Costo porcentual promedio de captación (CPP)
bank_deposit_avg_rate.note: Average cost of peso deposits (CPP) 5.22% in October 2026; the cost of term deposits at commercial banks (CCP) was 6.10%. World Bank deposit rate 2.55% (2025).

sanchayapatra_5y_rate.note: Mexico has no separate government savings certificate; individuals buy ordinary federal government securities (CETES, Bonos, Udibonos) directly through the government's Cetesdirecto programme (see the bill and bond slots).

tbill_91d_rate.sourceName: Banco de México (SIE) CF107, Valores gubernamentales, CETES 91 días, primary auction yield
tbill_91d_rate.note: 91-day CETES 6.69% at the auction of 29 October 2026 (6.75% on 22 October); 28-day 6.22%, 364-day 7.12%.

tbond_5y_rate.sourceName: Banco de México (SIE) CF107, Bonos de desarrollo a tasa fija 5 años, primary auction yield
tbond_5y_rate.note: 5-year fixed-rate government bond (Bono M) 8.78% at the auction of 29 October 2026.

tbond_10y_rate.sourceName: Banco de México (SIE) CF107, Bonos de desarrollo a tasa fija 10 años, primary auction yield
tbond_10y_rate.note: 10-year fixed-rate government bond 9.25% at the auction of 22 October 2026.

tax_bank_interest.sourceName: PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries, Mexico, withholding taxes (0.90% of invested capital)
tax_bank_interest.note: Banks withhold income tax at 0.90% a year of the capital invested, not of the interest; at a 6.2% deposit rate that is about 14.5% of the interest. The final tax is on real (inflation-adjusted) interest at the saver's marginal rate in the annual return. Page reviewed 6 August 2026.

tax_sanchayapatra_profit.sourceName: PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries, Mexico, withholding taxes (0.90% of invested capital)
tax_sanchayapatra_profit.note: No separate savings certificate; interest on government securities bought by individuals is subject to the same 0.90%-of-capital withholding (about 14.5% of a 6.2% yield), with final tax on real interest in the annual return.

deposit_insurance_limit.sourceName: IPAB, ¿Qué hacemos? (400,000 UDIs); UDI value from Banco de México SIE CP150
deposit_insurance_limit.note: IPAB covers bank deposits up to 400,000 UDIs per person per bank; with the UDI at about 8.89 pesos (Banxico CP150, early November 2026) that is about MXN 3.55 million.

credit_card_rate_cap.note: No legal cap on credit card interest was confirmed and Banxico's household credit table (CF303) shows no recent credit card figure (N/E for July-September 2026); Banxico's credit card indicators report could not be reached.

equity_return_low.sourceName: Mexican stock index (S&P/BMV IPC) weak 10-year record; CETES 364-day 7.12% gross (Banxico CF107)
equity_return_low.note: Low case: the local index repeats its weak decade, leaving equities below after-tax government bills.

equity_return_base.sourceName: After-tax 1-year CETES 7.12% less 0.90% withholding = 6.2% (Banxico CF107); Banxico 3% inflation target
equity_return_base.note: Base case: about 2.3 points over the after-tax safe rate, kept modest because the Mexican index has lagged over the past ten years.

equity_return_high.sourceName: Long-run emerging-market equity returns in local currency; Banxico CF107 yields
equity_return_high.note: High case: Mexican and global shares recover their long-run record in peso terms.

gold_return_low.sourceName: Gold USD 3,876/oz on 30 Oct 2026, 3% lower in a year and far below the January 2026 peak (Trading Economics); FIX MXN 18.80 per dollar
gold_return_low.note: Low case: gold flat in dollars and the peso stable.

gold_return_base.sourceName: Gold USD price trend (Trading Economics); expected peso depreciation of about 1-2 points a year (inflation gap with the US)
gold_return_base.note: Base case: gold tracks long-run dollar inflation plus a little, with the peso weakening slowly in line with the inflation gap.

gold_return_high.note: High case: gold resumes its 2020s uptrend and the peso weakens.

fixed_income_return_low.sourceName: 3-month fixed deposit 5.67% gross (Banxico CF117) less 0.90% withholding
fixed_income_return_low.note: Low case: rolling short bank deposits after the withholding tax.

fixed_income_return_base.note: Base case: one-year government bills (CETES) after withholding.

fixed_income_return_high.sourceName: Bono M 5 years 8.78% (Banxico CF107) less 0.90% withholding
fixed_income_return_high.note: High case: locking in five-year fixed-rate government bonds at today's yield.

life_claim_settlement_rate.note: The CNSF publishes insurance market statistics, but no industry-wide life claim settlement ratio was found.

insurance_term_premium_table.note: Term life cover is sold in Mexico, but no regulator or other non-company source with indicative premiums by age was found.

health_hospitalisation_cost.note: No regulator or statistics-office figure for the typical cost of a private hospital stay was found.

health_premium_table.note: No regulator or other non-company source of private health insurance premiums by age was found.

oop_health_share.note: Out-of-pocket spending was 41.2% of current health expenditure in 2023 (latest available; older than 2025).

goal_inflation_health.sourceName: Banxico CPI tables (INPC, INEGI); headline 3.45%, core 3.75% (September 2026)
goal_inflation_health.note: Medical prices in Mexico usually rise faster than general prices; planning uses 5%, about 1 point above projected inflation.

goal_inflation_education.sourceName: Banxico SIE CP154: education (colegiaturas) index 149.1 in September 2026 vs 145.5 for headline CPI (base 2Q July 2018 = 100)
goal_inflation_education.note: School fees have risen faster than general prices since 2018 and step up each school year; planning uses 5.5%.

life_table_remaining.sourceName: UN World Population Prospects via georank.org
life_table_remaining.note: Remaining years derived from the 'life expectancy by current age' table for 2026 (UN WPP).

support_ratio.sourceName: World Bank SP.POP.DPND.OL (2025); UN WPP via populationpyramid.net (2040, 2065)
support_ratio.note: 100 / old-age dependency ratio: 12.6 in 2025 (World Bank), 20.2 in 2040 and 36.7 in 2065 (UN WPP medium variant).

retirement_age_default.note: The IMSS pension age under the 1997 Social Security Law (old-age pension at 65, reduced 'cesantía' pension from 60) could not be confirmed: the IMSS site refused access and the Chamber of Deputies law library (Ley del Seguro Social) could not be reached.

retirement_age_government.note: The ISSSTE retirement age for federal employees under the 2007 ISSSTE Law could not be confirmed from an official source that could be reached.

retirement_return_low.sourceName: 3-month fixed deposit 5.67% gross (Banxico CF117) less 0.90% withholding
retirement_return_low.note: Low case: rolling short deposits after withholding, allowing for lower rates as Banxico eases.

retirement_return_base.note: Base case: mostly CETES and short government bonds, kept below the 6.2% after-tax one-year bill rate.

retirement_return_high.sourceName: Bono M 5 years 8.78% less 0.90% withholding (Banxico CF107)
retirement_return_high.note: High case: a ladder of medium-term fixed-rate government bonds at today's yields.

retirement_accumulation_return_low.sourceName: After-tax bills and deposits 4.8-6.2%; equity low case 4% (Banxico CF107, CF117)
retirement_accumulation_return_low.note: Low case for a balanced mix of government securities and equity.

retirement_accumulation_return_base.note: Base case: roughly half peso government securities and half equity.

retirement_accumulation_return_high.sourceName: Equity high 11%; Bono M 5 years 8.8% (Banxico CF107)
retirement_accumulation_return_high.note: High case: equities do well and bond yields stay high.

old_age_allowance_monthly.sourceName: Programas para el Bienestar, Pensión para el Bienestar de las Personas Adultas Mayores
old_age_allowance_monthly.note: MXN 6,400 paid every two months (MXN 3,200 a month) to everyone 65 or over; the page does not state the year, and 6,400 is the 2026 amount (6,200 in 2025). Women aged 60-64 can receive a separate Pensión Mujeres Bienestar.

old_age_allowance_eligibility.sourceName: Programas para el Bienestar, Pensión para el Bienestar de las Personas Adultas Mayores
old_age_allowance_eligibility.note: Universal: Mexican by birth or naturalisation, living in Mexico, aged 65 or over, regardless of income; registration at a Bienestar module during open registration periods.

gratuity_rule.sourceName: Ley Federal del Trabajo, articles 162 and 486 (Chamber of Deputies text, last reform 12 June 2015, hosted on gob.mx)
gratuity_rule.note: Prima de antigüedad: 12 days' wages per year of service for permanent workers, paid on dismissal (justified or not), on justified separation, and on voluntary resignation after at least 15 years; the daily wage counted is capped at twice the minimum wage. The text read is the 2015 consolidated version (older than 2025); article 162 has not changed since. Separate severance (3 months plus 20 days per year) applies to unjustified dismissal.

public_pension_scheme.note: The IMSS contributory pension (individual AFORE accounts under the 1997 law, with a guaranteed minimum pension) could not be documented from an official source that could be reached (IMSS refused access; the Chamber of Deputies law library was down).

fdr_3m.localName: Depósito a plazo fijo a 3 meses

fdr_1y.localName: Depósito a plazo fijo a 1 año
fdr_1y.note: Banks offer 1-year term deposits and pagarés, but Banxico publishes average rates only up to 6 months.

dps.note: No standard recurring-deposit product with a published rate; regular savers use savings accounts or scheduled purchases of CETES through Cetesdirecto.

sanchayapatra_5y.note: No separate retail savings certificate; individuals buy ordinary federal government securities through the government's Cetesdirecto programme.

tbill_91d.localName: CETES (Certificados de la Tesorería de la Federación)

tbond_5y.localName: Bonos de Desarrollo a tasa fija (Bonos M)

tbond_10y.localName: Bonos de Desarrollo a tasa fija (Bonos M)

equity_fund.localName: Fondos de inversión de renta variable
equity_fund.note: Equity funds and index-tracking exchange-traded funds are sold to retail investors through regulated intermediaries.

gold.note: Banco de México's gold bullion coins are legal tender and can be bought and sold by individuals.

insuranceRegulator.name: Comisión Nacional de Seguros y Fianzas (CNSF)

insuranceComplaints.name: Comisión Nacional para la Protección y Defensa de los Usuarios de Servicios Financieros (CONDUSEF)

pensionScheme.name: Instituto Mexicano del Seguro Social (IMSS) pensions, with individual accounts supervised by CONSAR

oldAgeAllowance.name: Pensión para el Bienestar de las Personas Adultas Mayores

publicHealthCover.name: IMSS-Bienestar (free public health care for people without social security)

depositInsurance.name: Instituto para la Protección al Ahorro Bancario (IPAB)

statistics.name: Instituto Nacional de Estadística y Geografía (INEGI)
